newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia falls, tests FIM 200 support.
newsitem.headline: Nokia falls, tests FIM 200 support.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy fell sharply in late Helsinki trade as bears gripped overseas markets, testing 200.00 markka where brokers saw strong support for the stock.

At 1655/1355 GMT, Nokia was down 9.00 markka or over four percent at 200.00 after touching 199.00. But volume for the Helsinki bellwether was not massive at around 130 million markka. Nokia was also marked down in New York.

Brokers said sentiment in Helsinki had been soured by Wall Street's overnight weakness and by sporting goods group Amer's result which failed to deliver the positive earnings surprise some had hoped for.
